commits.message:
A press reads its glyph off the frame it lands on: every drawn cell carries its offset, and the screen order is read off the drawn row (rich-control-codes-xh4n.3f7)

A multiline press judged whether the frame drew the end slot from the current
cursor, so after the cursor moved, a press in a right-to-left row landed a glyph
off. The row is now drawn once, each glyph stamped with a Slot, and the press and
the arrow keys read their stops from that drawn row; only under logical, where
the terminal orders the row, is shownOrder applied over it.

Pin: a removable control between a glyph and its extender writes as wide as it measures (rich-control-codes-xh4n.5md) (#563)

* Pin that a removable control between a glyph and its extender writes as wide as it measures under every order (rich-control-codes-xh4n.5md)

RichText.measure has read orient's measured(text, order) since #534, so it
drops the controls the wire drops; the probe that filed this compared raw
cellLen against a removing order's row. Every order and span edge agreed on
master; this pins it, and fails if measure stops being order-aware.

* Fold the removed-control pin into the span-edge describe: one edged helper over the order, one options set, the vacuous Panel case and the non-removing logical order dropped (rich-control-codes-xh4n.5md)

* Pin the removed-control width under logical too, and the width each order draws, not only that measure and wire agree (rich-control-codes-xh4n.5md)
